Proposition
[Pinched expander curvature decay (Proposition 27.23)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0035 1. ch27:27.23\group Scalar curvature bounds

If an expanding GRS has $\Rc \ge \eta Rg$ with $\eta >0$ and $R>0$, then for every $\widetilde\eta <\eta $, $R(x)\le C\exp (-\widetilde\eta d(x,\widetilde O)^2)$.
